notes.lapRecord: Race lap records count races from 2004 on: the race data has no fastest-lap times before 2004.
notes.poleRecord: Pole records use the pole-winning qualifying lap. Qualifying times are complete from 2003; 1994-2002 has some rounds only.
notes.championship: Race counts, wins and poles cover World Championship Grands Prix only, not non-championship races. The Indianapolis 500 (1950-1960) is left out of wins and poles.
notes.raceLaps: Race laps is the scheduled distance: the lap count most winners on the layout completed, so shortened races don't change it.
notes.missingTimes: missingTimes lists races on a layout whose lap or pole time is missing from the race data; a record may be faster than shown until they are filled.
